title: ACA s. 16 — Competence of arbitral tribunal (Kompetenz-Kompetenz) (ACA s. 16)

content.overview: Section 16 embodies kompetenz-kompetenz and separability. The arbitral tribunal may rule on its own jurisdiction, including objections to the existence or validity of the arbitration agreement. An arbitration clause forming part of a contract is treated as an agreement independent of the other contract terms. Jurisdictional pleas must be raised within the statutory time; the tribunal may admit a delayed plea where delay is justified. If the tribunal rejects the plea, it continues and makes the award, subject to the later statutory court remedy.
